Feel free to check my poll and harass me all you want. These early polls aren't concrete. Preseason is just pulling guesses out of your ass and Week 1 everyone is still shaking off the rust.

1.) Ohio State over Michigan. Both dominated the field and blew out their opponent. I didn't get to watch either game much, but I use the S&P rankings to help determine my rankings. Ohio State won 77-10 over a Bowling Green team with an S&P rank of 60. Michigan won 63-3 to a S&P ranked 117 Hawaii. I personally believe Michigan will in time end up higher than tOSU, but right now all I've got is this one game. Michigan had a little rust to shake off and they were playing a team that already played one game in Australia and has to make quite the journey.

2.) Houston > Oklahoma > Wisconsin > LSU & Texas > Notre Dame With this one, all four teams looked great. Houston being Top 20 and beating Top 5 Oklahoma and Unranked Wisconsin beating Top 5 LSU. Obviously Houston and Wisconsin beating Oklahoma and LSU they need to be ranked above the losers. However, since it was Week 1 I've got to take most the results with a grain of salt. LSU didn't lose by much, but in my opinion still looked like they can do well (they just need to get their shit together). Wisconsin also looked very good, but only won by two and could have lost if not for the pick. Houston played lights out against Oklahoma and in my personal opinion Oklahoma played very well also. Houston just ended up on the winning side.

Same goes for Texas > Notre Dame. Texas played incredibly well against ND and won narrowly in OT. Obviously Texas goes above ND, but with how the two played, they look to be right next to each other in terms of skill. We'll see if Texas can keep it going and show us that beating ND wasn't a fluke. What do you thing @sapo?

3.) I don't have much sympathy for teams that play FCS. I don't care if they won handily or whatever the case. You should beat the FCS team.

That game could have gone either way, for sure. If it weren't for that targeting non-call, I'm pretty sure we would have lost. We're too young and fresh off suckitude to hold a lead against any team that doesn't have glaring issues of thier own.

Is Notre Dame the better team? Probably, but until they sort their own QB situation out, and stop having starters areested for stupid shit, we win that game 3/5 times played.
